image_manifest.description: A 3D rendered asset manifest showing the aerial race referee for the Racing Pterosaurs game, suspended high in the air near a cliffside raceway.

assets.name: Pterosaur Race Referee
assets.description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist with braided black hair and African ethnicity (dino_bones_paleontologist_6). She is wearing a bright yellow aerial safety helmet with strap details, a white tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts, and black hiking boots. She is seated safely in a harness attached to a hang glider, looking energetic and ready to signal the start of the race.

assets.name: Hang Glider
assets.description: A high-visibility, lightweight hang glider with a bright yellow and red wing frame keeping the referee safely suspended mid-air.

assets.name: Starting Flag
assets.description: A vibrant, checkered racing flag held out and waved high with one hand, fluttering in the wind to signal the race start.

assets.name: Aerial Cliffside Environment
assets.description: A high-altitude, open-sky environment inspired by Cretaceous coastal cliffs. Bright blue sky with sweeping cirrus clouds and distant limestone canyon cliffs far below.

assets.name: Visual Effects
assets.description: Wind swirl lines around the flag and glider wings to emphasize motion and high altitude, with bright sun flares catching the edge of the glider frame.

assets.name: Bottom Right Watermark
assets.description: A small, translucent four-pointed star lens-flare logo located in the bottom-right corner.

image_manifest.constraints: No people other than the referee. Square aspect ratio, 1:1. Focus entirely on the referee's body language and airborne pose signaling the start of the race. Ensure safety helmet is clearly visible. No title bars or borders.
